0.4.0.description:
blue spheres
	clear - 1 check for clearing each blue sphere stage
	perfect - 2 checks per stage, 1 for clearing, 1 for perfecting
goal types
	bad ending - beat TMZ2
	good ending - get 7 emeralds to beat ERZ
	true ending - beat any ending with knuckles & knuckles
actsanity - split unlocking zones into unlocking acts
achievements checks
dlc toggle - toggle whether mighty/ray are included

ringlink added
deathlink added

big rings are now wireframes after being collected
emerald count is now shown on level select
act transitions no longer carry to different zones
super transformations now work
fixed pgz1 sending the wrong check
